name: ratatui-justified-text
instr:
Please add justified text alignment to Ratatui in `/app`, including discretionary word breaks for styled paragraphs. Don't add new crates.

Add unit variant `ratatui::layout::HorizontalAlignment::Justify`, also through `ratatui::layout::Alignment`, with the enum's existing traits and case-sensitive display/parsed spelling `Justify`. Support existing alignment setters and consuming shortcuts `ratatui::text::Line::justified(self) -> Self`, `ratatui::text::Text::justified(self) -> Self`, and `ratatui::widgets::Paragraph::justified(self) -> Self`, equivalent to `.alignment(Alignment::Justify)`.

For fitting lines, preserve original graphemes and spaces. Expandable gaps are maximal ASCII-space runs with non-space graphemes on both sides, irrespective of span boundaries. Divide surplus display cells evenly among gaps, leftmost remainder first. Append extra spaces after original spaces using the last original space's effective style. Non-ASCII whitespace isn't expandable. For example, `a b c` in width 10 becomes `a    b   c`. Empty, gapless and overlong lines behave as Left; zero-sized areas render nothing.

Standalone Line/Text and unwrapped Paragraph justify every fitting line. Nonzero unwrapped horizontal scroll disables expansion and uses Left scrolling. With Wrap, apply wrapping/trim before expansion, retaining surviving edge spaces; justify only non-final fragments of each source line. Finality ignores viewport clipping and vertical scroll; wrapped horizontal scroll is ignored
